clue.text: A side or two director called for

clue.text: Compete passionately but take silly risks?

explanation.definitionFit: Ghostlier is the comparative of ghostly, more spectral and insubstantial, like a phantom.

clue.text: Reagan's first lady set up trendy American restaurant

in a down clue, set up means raised so it reads bottom to top

blocks.note: the first letter of the name

taken as written

explanation.surface: Three overweight people swim in the river Tees.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tees is a river in north-east England; spoken, it is two letters T.
explanation.definitionFit: Tit for tat is retaliation in kind, an equivalent blow returned, so a way of getting even.

taken as written

taken as written, removed

clue.text: Hot chocolate drunk 24/7

blocks.note: both words taken as written, all fourteen letters used

blocks.note: temper is anger
taken as written

clue.text: Station attendant overlooking one little room

the Roman numeral for one, removed

clue.text: I'm with editor, tucking into contents of open hamper

blocks.note: taken as written

blocks.note: taken as written

the first letter of the word

clue.text: Unlikely means of switching channels
